en: The image shows a vintage illustrated postcard. The foreground features a woman in period clothing (long skirt, blouse, and hat) standing on a forest path, gazing toward a rocky hilltop with the ruins of a castle or fortress atop it. On the left, there is a boxed area with German text 'Gruss aus dem Riesengebirge - Kynast vom Höllengrund'. There is handwritten text at the bottom and left of the card, likely a personal message.
